paragraphs: The backend uses a reviewed local NYC ZIP Code Tabulation Area reference and needs no routing API key or payment card. GEMINIAPIKEY is only for optional server-side explanations. Never prefix secret keys with NEXTPUBLIC or commit .env.local. Explore calls the same-origin retailer API and loads an OpenStreetMap basemap. Store coordinates and computed distances come from the validated local dataset. Info offers optional, explicitly opted-in typed Shosai guidance; Explore and screening do not call Gemini.
features: For optional local Shosai guidance, copy .env.example to .env.local, set GEMINIAPIKEY, and keep the verified server-only GEMINIMODEL=gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Otherwise no provider configuration is needed.
